description: Figure: pocket-position comparison, structural distances in the superposed PP_2928 model, and family identity matrix
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
OUT="/agent/jobs/ddbdc7c3-ea00-49cb-a873-e155d8048779/provenance"
D=json.load(open(f"{OUT}/nw_maps.json")); maps=D["maps"]

ENZ=[("SPNEU_38LX_A0A0H2ZP94","S. pneumoniae (38LX, agmatine+NADPH)","agmatine"),
     ("CLEPT_CAPADH_A7VSG1","C. leptum CAPA-DH","agmatine"),
     ("BFRAG_CAPADH_I9VY56","B. fragilis CAPA-DH","agmatine"),
     ("BTHETA_BT4612_Q89YW9","B. thetaiotaomicron BT_4612","agmatine (inferred)"),
     ("HPYL_CASDH_O26037","H. pylori CASDH","putrescine"),
     ("CJEJ_CASDH_Q0PBW7","C. jejuni Cj0172c CASDH","putrescine"),
     ("VCHOL_CANSDH_Q9KRL3","V. cholerae CANSDH VC_1624","1,3-diaminopropane"),
     ("PSEPK_PP2928_Q88IS1","P. putida PP_2928 (query)","?")]
POS=[(86,"wall"),(106,"loop"),(107,"loop"),(108,"loop N"),(109,"loop Y"),(110,"loop E"),(111,"loop+1"),
     (162,"ASA D"),(163,"ASA P"),(202,"ASA F"),(206,"ruler I"),(210,"E"),(250,"H"),(251,"E/D")]
grid=np.zeros((len(ENZ),len(POS))); labs=[[""]*len(POS) for _ in ENZ]
ref={p:maps["SPNEU_38LX_A0A0H2ZP94"][str(p)][1] for p,_ in POS}
for i,(k,_,_) in enumerate(ENZ):
    for j,(p,_) in enumerate(POS):
        m=maps[k].get(str(p))
        if m is None: grid[i,j]=2; labs[i][j]="-"
        else:
            labs[i][j]=m[1]
            grid[i,j]= 0 if m[1]==ref[p] else 1
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(16.5,11.5))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2, height_ratios=[1.15,1], width_ratios=[1.45,1], hspace=0.34, wspace=0.26)

# Panel A
axA=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
cols={0:"#CFE8D5",1:"#F2B8A8",2:"#E4E4E4"}
for i in range(len(ENZ)):
    for j in range(len(POS)):
        axA.add_patch(Rectangle((j,len(ENZ)-1-i),1,1, facecolor=cols[grid[i,j]], edgecolor="white", lw=1.6))
        axA.text(j+0.5, len(ENZ)-1-i+0.5, labs[i][j], ha="center", va="center", fontsize=12.5,
                 fontweight="bold" if grid[i,j]==1 else "normal", color="#1b1b1b")
axA.set_xlim(0,len(POS)); axA.set_ylim(0,len(ENZ))
axA.set_xticks(np.arange(len(POS))+0.5)
axA.set_xticklabels([f"{p}\n{t}" for p,t in POS], fontsize=10.5)
axA.set_yticks(np.arange(len(ENZ))+0.5)
axA.set_yticklabels([f"{n}   [{sub}]" for _,n,sub in ENZ][::-1], fontsize=11)
axA.set_title("A  Substrate-pocket positions of the 1.19 A agmatine complex (PDB 38LX), mapped across the family\n"
              "green = same as the agmatine-bound reference, orange = substituted, grey = indel",
              fontsize=12.5, loc="left")
for sp in axA.spines.values(): sp.set_visible(False)
axA.tick_params(length=0)
axA.add_patch(Rectangle((3,0),3,len(ENZ), fill=False, edgecolor="#B03030", lw=2.6, zorder=5))
axA.text(4.5, len(ENZ)+0.18, "guanidinium recognition loop", ha="center", fontsize=10.5, color="#B03030")
axA.add_patch(Rectangle((13,0),1,len(ENZ), fill=False, edgecolor="#B03030", lw=2.6, zorder=5))
axA.text(13.5, len(ENZ)+0.18, "2nd clamp", ha="center", fontsize=10.5, color="#B03030")

# Panel B: distances
axB=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
T=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/pp2928_structural_distances.csv")
T=T[T.PP2928.isin(["A91","I113","H114","E115","E200","H240","D241","I196","D152","P153","F192"])]
T=T.sort_values("d_guanidinium")
y=np.arange(len(T))
axB.barh(y-0.19, T.d_guanidinium, height=0.36, color="#B03030", label="to agmatine guanidinium")
axB.barh(y+0.19, T.d_NADPH, height=0.36, color="#3A6EA5", label="to NADPH")
axB.set_yticks(y); axB.set_yticklabels(T.PP2928+"  ("+T.maps_to+")", fontsize=10)
axB.axvline(3.5, color="#555", ls="--", lw=1.2); axB.text(3.55, len(T)-0.6, "3.5 A contact", fontsize=9.5, color="#555")
axB.set_xlabel("minimum heavy-atom distance (A)", fontsize=11)
axB.set_title("B  PP_2928 AlphaFold model superposed on 38LX\n340 Ca pairs, core RMSD 1.11 A, mean pLDDT 95.9", fontsize=12, loc="left")
axB.legend(fontsize=9.5, loc="lower right"); axB.grid(axis="x", alpha=0.25)
for sp in ["top","right"]: axB.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

# Panel C: identity matrix
axC=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
mat=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/identity_matrix.csv", index_col=0)
order=[e[0] for e in ENZ if e[0] in mat.index]
mat=mat.loc[order,order]
short={e[0]:e[1].split("(")[0].strip() for e in ENZ}
im=axC.imshow(mat.values, cmap="YlGnBu", vmin=35, vmax=100)
axC.set_xticks(range(len(order))); axC.set_xticklabels([short[o] for o in order], rotation=45, ha="right", fontsize=9)
axC.set_yticks(range(len(order))); axC.set_yticklabels([short[o] for o in order], fontsize=9)
for i in range(len(order)):
    for j in range(len(order)):
        v=mat.values[i,j]
        axC.text(j,i,f"{v:.0f}", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9, color="white" if v>70 else "#222")
axC.set_title("C  Pairwise sequence identity (%)\nPP_2928 is an outlier: closest to the V. cholerae\n1,3-diaminopropane enzyme (44.9%), not to any CASDH", fontsize=12, loc="left")
plt.show()
print(mat.loc["PSEPK_PP2928_Q88IS1"].sort_values(ascending=False).to_string())
